recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-25393 unless a future work group decision intentionally changes the payload advertising model or makes payload type mandatory again.
issue_request: FHIR-25393 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for FHIR-core Endpoint. It asked that Endpoint.payloadType either be optional or have a better value set; the final resolution was to update Endpoint.payloadType from 1..* to 0..*.
initial_application: No Endpoint source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-25393 was found. The same payload-type relaxation was applied through the broader Published/Persuasive FHIR-34261 Endpoint cardinality issue: commit 445d4741d1559c197decca8343f60d1cad753d36 changed the payload type minimum from 1 to 0 in source/endpoint/structuredefinition-Endpoint.xml.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/fhir.ini maps the former Endpoint.payloadType name to Endpoint.payload.type after the R5 payload refactor. Later Endpoint payload issues, including FHIR-40247 and FHIR-39616/FHIR-39617, reorganized and clarified payload advertising while preserving optional payload type cardinality. FHIR-36074 was a duplicate request for Endpoint.payloadType 0..*; its comments say the primary payload-type change was already covered by other trackers.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current Endpoint StructureDefinition already defines Endpoint.payload.type with min 0 and max *, which satisfies the FHIR-25393 decision.
